name: rls_disabled_in_public
title: RLS Disabled in Public
description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has not been enabled on tables in schemas exposed to PostgREST
detail: Table `public.tasks` is public, but RLS has not been enabled.

name: rls_references_user_metadata
title: RLS references user metadata
description: Detects when a row level security (RLS) policy references the `user_metadata` field, which is editable by end users and should never be used in a security context.
detail: Table `public.projects` has a row level security policy `projects_owner_only` that references Supabase Auth `user_metadata`. `user_metadata` is editable by end users and should never be used in a security context.

name: security_definer_view
title: Security Definer View
description: Detects views defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property. These views enforce Postgres permissions and row level security policies (RLS) of the view creator, rather than that of the querying user.
detail: View `public.task_summary` is defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property

name: auth_rls_initplan
title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
description: Detects if calls to `current_setting()` and `auth.<function>()` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row
detail: Table `public.tasks` has a row level security policy `tasks_owner_only` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Replace `auth.<function>()` with `(select auth.<function>())`.
